pub trait Chat
  type Error
  fn start(&self, request: Request) -> Result<Admission, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, operation: String, cursor: i64, max_deltas: i64, max_bytes: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<DeltaPage, Self::Error>
  fn cancel(&self, operation: String) -> Result<Cancellation, Self::Error>
pub struct ChatClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Embedder
  type Error
  fn embed(&self, request: EmbedRequest) -> Result<Embeddings, Self::Error>
pub struct EmbedderClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T

  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T

pub trait Live
  type Error
  fn start(&self, request: LiveRequest) -> Result<Admission, Self::Error>
  fn append(&self, operation: String, sequence: i64, audio: Vec<u8>) -> Result<LiveInputResult, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, operation: String, cursor: i64, max_deltas: i64, max_bytes: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<DeltaPage, Self::Error>
  fn commit(&self, operation: String) -> Result<LiveInputResult, Self::Error>
  fn cancel(&self, operation: String) -> Result<Cancellation, Self::Error>
pub struct LiveClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Image
  type Error
  fn start(&self, request: ImageRequest) -> Result<Admission, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, operation: String, cursor: i64, max_deltas: i64, max_bytes: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<DeltaPage, Self::Error>
  fn cancel(&self, operation: String) -> Result<Cancellation, Self::Error>
pub struct ImageClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Operator
  type Error
  fn hosts(&self) -> Result<HostList, Self::Error>
  fn add_host(&self, expected_revision: String, host: HostEntry) -> Result<HostChange, Self::Error>
  fn remove_host(&self, expected_revision: String, name: String) -> Result<HostChange, Self::Error>
  fn keys(&self) -> Result<KeyList, Self::Error>
  fn issue_key(&self, program: String, credential: String) -> Result<KeyIssued, Self::Error>
  fn revoke_key(&self, program: String) -> Result<KeyRevoked, Self::Error>
  fn audit(&self, cursor: i64, max_entries: i64) -> Result<AuditPage, Self::Error>
  fn gateway(&self) -> Result<GatewayState, Self::Error>
  fn set_gateway(&self, expected_revision: String, open: bool, address: String) -> Result<GatewayChange, Self::Error>
pub struct OperatorClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
